1. Israeli wote wakanung'unika, Musa na Haruni,
ingekuwa heri kama tungekufa, katika nchi ya
Misiri, kuliko kufa jangwani
Msiwe na tabia ya kupenda fedha, mwe
radhi na vitu mlivyonavyo, Yahweh asema
sitapungukiwa, wala sitakuacha kabisa

2. Mbona Yahweh atuleta mpaka nchi hii?
Tuanguke kwa upanga wake, watoto wetu na
wake zetu, watakuwa mateka, je si afadhali
turudi misiri?

3. Wakashikwa na tamaa wana wa Israeli,
wakalia tena, nani atakayetupa nyama tule?
Twakumbuka samaki tuliokula, yale matango
na matikiti, na mboga na vitunguu

4. Yahweh akanena na Musa na Haruni, na
kuwaambia, nimeyasikia manung’uniko yao,
kama walivyonena nitawafanyia ninyi,
mizoga yenu itaanguka, katika jangwa hili

5. Nimeweka Yahweh mbele yangu, kwa kuwa
yuko kuumeni kwangu, na moyo wangu
unashangilia, mwili utakaa kwa kutumaini.

title: Nayo Rehema Na Ukweli
lyrics:
1. Heri aonaye hekima, yule apataye ufahamu,
biashara yake ni bora, kuliko biashara ya
fedha
Nayo rehema na ukweli, uzifunge shingoni
mwako, ziandike juu ya moyo wako, upate
kibali mbele za Yahweh

2. Yahweh ana wingi wa siku, katika mkono wa
kuume, utajiri na heshima katika mkono wa
kushoto

3. Yahweh aliweka misingi, ya nchi kwa hekima
yake, na tena kwa akili zake, kazifanya
mbingu imara

4. Laana ya Yahweh i katika, nyumbani mwao
walio waovu, bali kwao walio na haki,
huibariki maskani yao

5. Huwadharau wenye dharau, huwapa
wanyenyekevu neema, wenye haki ni kama
nuru, nao waovu ni kama giza

6. Yahweh atakuwa tumaini, hutaogopa hofu ya
wokovu, uharibifu utakapo fika, yeye
atakuokoa.

title: Matunda Yangu
lyrics:
1. Nawapenda wale wanipendao,wanitafutao
wataiona, utajiri na heshima ni kwangu, utajiri
udumuo na haki
Matunda yangu hupita dhahabu na faida
hupita fedha,natembea katika haki, na katika
mapito ya bahari

2. Wanipendao nawaridhisha mali, na kuzijaza
hazina zao, sikieni mafundisho yangu, mpate
hekima msikatae

3. Ana heri asikizaye, akihubiri malangoni
pangu, akingoja penye vizingiti, anionaye ana
uzima

4. Anikosaye yeye hujidhuru, wanichukiao
hupenda mauti, kumcha Yahweh ni mwanzo
wa hekima, kumjua ni ufahamu

5. Mwelimishe mwenye hekima, atazidi kuwa na
hekima, mfundishe mwenye hekima, atazidi
kuwa na elimu

6. Kumcha Yahweh kwaongeza siku, wasio haki
miaka itapunguzwa, matumaini yao wenye
haki, yatakuwa furaha yao.

title: Wakala Chakula Cha Roho
lyrics:
1. Baba zetu walikuwa chini ya wingu, wote
wakapita kati ya bahari, wakabatizwa wawe
wa Musa, katika wingu na bahari
Wakala chakula kile cha roho, wakanywa
kinywaji kile cha roho, waliunywea mwamba
wa roho, na mwamba ulikuwa Yahshua

2. Wengi sana kati yao waliangamizwa, maana
Yahweh hakupendezwa nao, mambo hayo
yakawa mifano kwetu, tusiwe watu
wakutamani

3. Yatendeni yote bila manung’uniko,mpate
kuwa wana wa Yahweh, wasio na lawama
muonekane kuwa mianga ya ulimwengu

4. Msiwe waabudu sanamu, kama wao
walivyokuwa, wala kumjaribu Yahweh
muumba, msije mkaangamia .

title: Kufadhili Wageni
lyrics:
1. Yahweh akamtokea Ibrahimu, karibu na
mialoni ya Mamre, alipokuwa ameketi
mlangoni, pa hema yake wakati wa hari
Upendano wenu ndugu na udumuo, msisahau
kuwafadhili wageni, wengine
wamewakaribisha malaika Kwa njia hii
pasipo kujua

2. Akainua macho yake akaona, watatu
wamesimama mbele yake, kapiga mbio
kwenda kuwalaki, naye akainama mpaka chini

3. Yahweh wangu kama nimeona fadhili,
machani pako nakuamba usinipite, kawaletea
maji wanawe miguu, na chakula wakapata
kuburudika

4. Wakumbukeni hao waliofungwa, kana
kwamba mmefungwa pamoja, kutenda mema
na kushirikiana, ndizo dhabihu apendazo
Yahweh.

title: Msulubishe
lyrics:
1. Walifanya shauri juu ya kumuua Yahshua,
wakampeleka kwa liwali Pilato
Walipaaza sauti kuu, msulubishe msulubishe,
wakatoa sauti zao wakitaka asulubiwe

2. Naye Pilato akawaambia sijaona lolote,
alilofanya Yahshua wenu lipasalo kifo

3. Enyi binti wa Yahrusalemu, msiomboleze,
jililieni nafsi zenu na watoto wenu

4. Wakaweka taji la miiba juu ya kichwa chake,
kapiga magoti mbele zake, wakamdhihaki

5. Kukawa giza kuu sana juu ya nchi, nalo pazia
la hekalu, likapasuka.

title: Magugu
lyrics:
1. Ufalme wa Yahweh wafanana, na aliyepanda
mbegu njema, akaja adui akapanda, magugu
akaenda zake
Mbegu njema ni wana wa ufalme, nayo
magugu wana wa uasi, naye adui ni ibilisi,
mavuno ni mwisho wa dunia

2. Pia ufalme wafananishwa na punje ya
haradali, aliyoitwaa mkulima, akapanda kwa
shamba lake

3. Wenye uasi watatupwa, katika tanuru ya
moto, wenye haki watang’aa ufalme wa baba
yao.

title: Tunda La Roho
lyrics:
1. Yahweh ndiye wokovu wangu, mimi
sitaogopa, Yahweh ndiye nguvu zangu, pia
wimbo wangu
Tunda la roho ni upendo, furaha, amani,
uvumilivu, utu wema, fadhili, uaminifu

2. Kwa furaha mtayateka, maji katika visima,
myatangaze matendo yake, kati ya mataifa

3. Roho na bibi arusi, wasema njoo, mwenye kiu
na aje, ayatwae maji ya uzima

4. Amwaminye Messiah, kama andiko
lisemavyo, mito ya maji yaliyo hai,
itabubunjika ndani yake.

title: Jina La Yahweh
lyrics:
1. Yahweh baba wa Ibrahimu na Isaka hata
Israeli, jina lako hata milele, toka kizazi hadi
kizazi
Jina la Yahweh ni jina la dhamana x3
wamwitao wataokoka x2

2. Watu wako watoa dhabihu, ya uvumba na hata
dhahabu, toka mawio na hata machweo, jina
lako ni jina kuu sana

3. Yahweh baba akanena na Musa, akampa jina
lake, awaendee Waisraeli, awaokoe toka
utumwani

4. Yawapasa wanaume wasalipo kila mahali,
wainue mikono yao, iliyotakata mbele za
Yahweh.

title: Sabato
lyrics:
1. Kazi ya siku sita, imerudi nyuma, sabato la
Yahweh, nalo laingia
T umeingia, katika furaha, tulioandaliwa na
Yahshua Messiah

2. Imani yako ndugu, itakuwezesha kufurahia,
siku ya sabato

3. Twanyenyekea mbele zake muumba wetu,
twaomba kutakazwa, kwa damu ya Yahshua

4. Kafanya kazi yake kwa siku sita, akaitakasa
siku ya saba

5. Utubariki, utufadhili, maana umetukuka
hakuna kama wewe.

title: Jeshi La Mbingu
lyrics:
1. Ee Yahweh kazifanya, mbingu na nchi,
pamoja na jeshi lako, na vyote vilivyomo
duniani, lihimidiwe jina lako milele.
Jeshi la mbingu lakutukuza, ulimchagua
Aburamu, kutoka kwa Wakalidayo, na kumpa
jina Ibrahimu

2. Ulifanya agano na Ibrahimu, kampa nchi
kuwapa wazao, uliyaona mateso ya baba zetu,
katika nchi ya Misiri

3. Kapasua bahari wakapita, katikati kama nchi
kavu, adui zao waliowafuata, ukawatuoa
vilidini

4. Kawapa nguzo la wingu mchana, na nguzo la
moto usiku, ili kuwapa mwanga katika njia
iliyowapasa kuiendea

5. Hukumu na sheria heria akawapa, kawajulisha
sabato yako Yahweh, akawapa chakula toka
mbinguni, na maji yakatoka mwambani.

title: Hannah Akaomba
lyrics:
1. Hannah akaomba akasema, moyo wangu
wamlilia Yahweh baba, pembe yangu
umetukuka katika Yahweh, kinywa changu
juu ya adui zangu
Kwa kuwa naufurahia wokovu wako, hakuna
aliye mtakatifu, hakuna mwamba kama wewe
Yahweh, hakuna yeyote ila wewe

2. Msizidi kunena kwa kutakabari, majivuno
yasitoke vinywani mwenu, kwa kuwa Yahweh
ni baba wa maarifa, na hupima matendo kwa
mizani

3. Pinde za mashujaa zimevijika, waliojikwaa
wamefungwa nguvu, walipokuwa njaa
wamepata raha, na walioshiba
wamejikondisha

4. Aliyekuwa tasa amezaa, aliye na wana wengi
amedhoofika, Yahweh huua pia hufanya hai
hushusha chini tena huinua

5. Humwinua mnyonge toka mavumbini,
hupandisha mhitaji toka njaani ili awaketishe
pamoja na wakuu, wakakirithi kiti cha enzi.

title: Sameheaneni
lyrics:
1. Nawaomba ndugu zangu, muendapo kusali
mpate kusameheana kama Yahweh alivyo
Sameheaneni, mara saba kwa mara sabini
Yahshua asema

2. Basi iweni na huruma kama Yahweh alivyo,
tena iweni wafadhili tena wenye hekima

3. Neno lake Messiah, na likae ndani yenu,
mzidi kuonyana kwa nyimbo na zaburi

4. Uzuie mwili wako, kufanya kisasi mbali
mpende jirani asema Yahweh

5. Mkichukuliana pia kusameheana, kama
nilivyo wasamehe, iweni na shukrani.

title: Pasaka
lyrics:
1. Yahshua akawatuma Petero na Yohana,
akawaambia waandae pasaka x2
Nimetamani kuila pasaka pamoja nanyi kabla
ya kuteswa kwangu.x2

2. Akaumega ule mkate, akashukuru baba
akawapa wale.x2

3. Akachukua kile kikombe, akashukuru baba
akawapa wanywe.x2

4. Alaye mwili wangu na kunywa damu yangu,
hula na hunywa hukumu ya nafsi yake.x2

5. Alaye mwili wangu na kunywa damu yangu,
anao uzima nami nitamfufua.x2

title: Sikieni Haya
lyrics:
1. Sikieni haya enyi mataifa yote, sikilizeni enyi
nyote mnaokaa, watu wakuu na watu wadogo
wote pia, tajiri na masikini wote pamoja
Nitatega sikio langu nisikie, na kufumbua
fumbo langu kwa kinubi

2. Kwa nini niogope siku za uovu, ubaya
ukinizunguka miguu pangu, hakuna mtu
awazaye kumkomboa, wala kumpa Yahweh
fidia kwa ajili

3. Kaburi ni nyumba zao hata milele, masikani
yao vizazi na vizazi, hao walioyataja
mashamba yao, kwa majina yao wakiwao
wenyewe

4. Chunga kutenda dhambi ewe peke yako, na
kufanya maovu, mbele za macho yako, ili
ujulikane kuwa una haki, unenapo na kuwa
safi utoapo.

title: Asante Yahweh Muweza
lyrics:
1. Asante Yahweh muweza, kwa kuniumba kwa
mfano wako kama ulivyokupendeza, ili
nikutumikie
Nisaidie baba kuenenda, katika njia zako,
nindumishe kwenye nyumba yako, mimi
mtumishi wako

2. Yahshua Messiah we u ngao yangu, mpenzi
wangu wa maisha, uliutoa moyo wako, ili
nipate wokovu

3. Mwenye dhambi akiamini malaika
washangilie, na kuliabudu jina la Yahshua
Halleluyah Hosana

4. Wamessia ni jukumu letu, kuitangaza injili ya
Yahshua, kwa mataifa wote wa duniani ili
wapate wokovu

5. Marafiki waliniasi, wakati nilipoamini,
kanikemea na kusema siwezi enda mbali.

title: Njooni Kwangu
lyrics:
1. Njoni kwangu ninyi, nyote msumbukao, na
mlemeao na mizigo nami nitawapumzisha
Tubuni kwa maana ufalme wa Yahweh u
karibu

2. Yahshua akamjibu akasema, amini amini
nakwambia, usipozaliwa mara ya pili,
hataurithi ufalme

3. Tukihesabiwa haki, kwa neema tupate urithi,
wa uzima wa milele kama ulivyo tumaini letu

4. Kwa maana Yahshua alikufa na akawa hai
tena, awamiliki waliokufa, na walio hai pia.

title: Kila Apendaye Mafundisho
lyrics:
1. Kila apendaye mafundisho, hupenda maarifa,
mbali achukiaye kulaumiwa ni kama mnyama
Kila mtu atakula wema, wa matunda ya
kinywa chake, mbali nafsi ya mtu haini itakula
jeuri

2. Shina la wenye haki halitaondolewa,
mwanamke mwema ni taji ya mumewe, bali
abishaye nikama kuoza mifupani mwake

3. Afadhali anayedharauliwa akiwa ana
mtumwa, kuliko ajisifuye ikiwa anataka
chakula

4. Maneno ya waovu huotea damu, bali
mwerevu husitiri aibu, atakaye maneno ya
kweli, hufunua haki.

title: Anayetakaswa
lyrics:
1. Nitafurahi sana katika Yahweh, nafsi yangu
itashangilia, maana amenivika vazi la
wokovu, amenifunika vazi la haki
A nayetakasa na watakaswao, wote wanatoka
kwa baba mmoja, kwa ajili hii Yahshua, haoni
haya, kuwaita njooni enyi ndugu zangu

2. Ametangaza habari duniani dhawabu ya binti
Zayuni i pamoja naye na malipo yake yako
mbele zake

3. Yahshua asema simba atayala majani,
mavumbi yatakuwa chakula cha joka, naye
mbwa mwitu na mwana kondoo, watalisha
pamoja patakatifu.

title: Twakutukuza (Psalms 144, 147,149)
lyrics:
1. Yahweh muumba Yahweh wa majeshi,
Twakushukuru tena twakutuza,
Umetenda mambo ya ajabu,
Jina lako na lihimidiwe ×2
Twakutukuza Yahweh wa majeshi, Pokea sifa utukufu
ni wako,
Jina lako na lihimidiwe ×2

2. Tumwimbieni Yahweh wimbo mpya,
tumfanyie kelele za shangwe, ndiye mwamba
wa wokovu wetu, jina lako na lihimdiwe ×2

3. Kwa vinubi zeze na filimbi, kwa matari pia
kwa kucheza, twa kusifu Yahweh wa majeshi,
jina lako na lihimdiwe ×2

4. Viumbe vyote na vikusifu wewe, Yahweh
katika patakatifu pako, upewe sifa utukufu ni
wako, jina lako na lihimidiwe ×2.

title: Utanena Nikuagizayo (Kutoka 7-11)
lyrics:
1. Yahweh akamwambia Musa, angalia
nimekufanya, kama muweza kwa Farao, naye
Haruni nabii wako ×2
Utanena nikuagizayo,
Haruni anene na Farao,
Awape Israeli ruhusa,
Ndiposa watoke nchi yake ×2

2. Haruni akaibwaga fimbo, yake chini ikawa
nyoka, wachawi waganga wakafanya, vivyo
hivyo kwa uganga wao ×2

3. Haruni tena kaunyosha, mko wake juu ya
maji, visiwa vyote na maziwa, ikageuka kuwa
damu ×2

4. Akainyosha tena fimbo, vyura, mainzi
wakatoka, ndipo uweza wake Yahweh,
ukaweza kudhihilika ×2

5. Na kwa ishara ya majipu, nzige, vifo vya
wanyama, vifo vya wazaliwa wa kwanza,
kadhihilisha uweza wa Yahweh ×2.

title: Ikipambazuka (Mathayo 28: 1-7)
lyrics:
1. Sop: Ikipambazuka siku ya kwanza ya juma,
All: Hata Sabato ilipokwisha, mariamu
Bass: Wote
Sop: Walikwenda,
All: Kulitazama kaburi ×2
Sop (Solo): Nayee
All: Malaika akawambia,
Bass: Msiogope ninyi
All: Kwa maana manaye mtafuta,
All: Yashuah messiah amekwish fufuka ×2

2. Sop: Malaika wa Yahweh alishuka toka
Mbinguni,
All: Kalivingirisha jiwe
Sop: Palikuwa, tetemeko
Bass: Kubwa
All : Walinzi wakatetemeka ×2

3. Sop: Malaika akawambia nendeni upesi,
All: Mkawambie wanafunzi wake,
Sop: Amefufuka
Bass: kaitaka wafu
All: Awatangulia kwenda Galilaya ×2

title: Kisha Nikaona (ufunuo 21:1-)
lyrics:
1. Kisha nikaona mbingu mpya na nchi mpya,
kwa maana za kwanza zimekwisha kupita,wala
hapana bahari tena kwa kuwa, zile za kwanza
zote zimekisha kupita ×2
Solo: Nami,
All: Nikauona mji ulue mtakatifu
Yahrusalemu mpya ukishuka toka mbinguni,
Naye, umerebeshwa kama bibi arusi,
Aliyekwisha kupambwa kwa ajili ya
mumewe × 2

2. Nikasikia sauti kubwa kutoka, katika kile kiti
cha enzi ikisema, tazama maskani ya Yahweh
na watu wake, naye Yahweh mwenyewe
atakuwa pamoja nao ×2

3. Naye atafuta machozi katika macho yao, kwa
kuwa mauti haitakuwapo tena, wala
maumivu maombolezo na kilio, kwa kuwa
mambo ya kwanza yamekwisha kupita ×2.

title: Leteni Zaka Kamili (Malachi 3: 7-10)
lyrics:
1. All: Tokea siku za baba zenu
Bass: Mmegeuka upande
All: Mkayaacha maagizo yangu ×2
Bass: Leteni
All: Zaka kamili ghalani
All: Kiwemo chakula nyumbani mwangu ×2

2. All: Mkanijaribu kwa njia hiyo
Bass: Yahweh wa majeshi asema
All: Tafungua madirisha ya mbinguni ×2

3. All: Ntawamwagieni baraka tele
Bass: Hata isiwepo nafasi
All: Isiwepo nafasi ya kutosha ×2

title: Twende Nyumbani Mwa Yahweh (Psalms : 122)
lyrics:
1. Nalifurahi waliponiambia twende, nyumbani
mwa Yahweh x2
Twende nyumbani mwa Yahweh x4

2. Miguu yetu imesimama ndani ya malango
ya malango yako, ee Yahrusalemu x2

3. Utakieni Yahrusalemu amani na
wafanikiwe wakupendao ee Yerusalemu x2

4. Amani na ikae ndani ya kuta zako na
kufanikiwa ndani ya majumba zako, ee
Yahrusalemu x2

title: Soma Zaburi
lyrics:
1. Soma Zaburi mia na sita, aya yake ni ya ishirini,
wakaubadili utukufu wa Yahweh, kwa mfano
wa sanamu ya ng'ombe
(Chorus)
Hosea mbili kumi na saba,
Nitayaondoa majina yote,
Majina yote ya mabaali,
Katika vinywa vya wateule

2. Yeremia mbili kumi na moja, watu wangu
wameubadili, utukufu wangu kwa kitu kisicho,
kitu kisicho na faida

3. Mika nne aya ya tano, tutaona siku zile za
mwisho, sisi tutaenda kwa jina la Yahweh, jina
la Yahweh muumba wetu.

title: Wivu
lyrics:
1. Yahweh kamuuliza, mtoto Kaini, mbona uso
wako, umekunjamana, kumbuka dhambi, ipo
mlangoni, lakini yapasa, uishinde dhambi
(Chorus) :
Ibilisi kama simba angurumaye,
Yupo nje anataka kutumeza,
Ndiye mshitaki wetu kwa Baba
Yahweh, kwa kila jambo tunalolitenda

2. Mifano katika, maandiko ni mingi, kuhusu
Sauli inatueleza, Daudi alipomshinda
Goliath, wivu ulimwingia, mfalme Sauli

3. Ndugu mliopo, hii ndiyo habari, toka hapo
kale, tulishasikia kwamba tupendane,
walioamini, kamuua nduguye, tusimwige
Kaini.

title: Furaha Iliyoje
lyrics:
1. Safari tunayoenda ya Zayuni ni safari
ngumu tujikazeni, baada ya mateso haya
yote, tutaingia kwenye furaha
Furaha iliyoje tukifika mji ambao
tuliahidiwa tukiimba na wateule wote
watakaoshinda hii safari

2. Waliotutangulia walipiga vita vizuri
wakawa washindi, lakini hawakupewa
ahadi wakitungoja tutoke safarini

3. Kifo, kilio hakutakuwa, wala huzuni
kwenye huo mji, itakuwa ni furaha ya
milele pamoja na Mkombozi wetu Yahshua

4. Ndugu mateso yakija vumilia, simama
wima upigane ukijua una dhawabu kuu
utakaposhinda yote ya dunia

5. Jamani Sheteni ako nyuma yetu akiwinda
roho ya kila mmoja, ili usifikie ile ahadi
uliyoahidiwa utakaposhinda.

title: Niongoze
lyrics:
1. Baba niko mbele yako na maombi,
nikikusihi usiniache mimi, kwani dunia
inanivuta nyuma, eeh Yahweh nitegee
sikio lako
Ee Yahweh wangu naomba niongoze katika
safari hii ya shida, kwani Shetani yu
nyuma mbiombio kwa lengo la kunifanya
nipotee

2. Nguo za kisasa na dijitali, zimefanya watu
kumsahau Yahweh, imekuwa njia ya
kupotea na kuelekea njia ya upotevuni

3. Kwani Sheteni amekuja na njia, ambazo
zinapendeza wanadamu, ili awatoe kwa
njia ya kweli, baba tupe nguva za
kumshinda

4. Baba tupe nguvu pia na hekima, ili tuweze
kuepuka mitego na mbinu zozote,
anazotumia kuwadhoofisha wateule wako.

title: Nitamwimbia
lyrics:
1. Ee Yahweh wangu nitakwimbia kwa yale
yote umenitendea, maana sina cha kukulipa
ila nikwimbie Yahweh wangu x2
Nitamwimbia muumba wangu, nitamchezea
nyimbo za sifa maana yeye ni Yahweh
sababu yeye ndiye mkuu

2. Alimtoa mwana wake, ili akufe kwa
dhambi zangu, sina chochote cha kumlipa
ila nimwimbie Yahweh wangu x2

3. Alinitoa mataifani, nilikuwa mimi simjui
akakufa pale juu ya mti ili asafishe uovu
wangu x2

4. Baba naomba nishikilie mimi, nisimezwe
na dunia, hakuna kitu nilikuja nacho, wala
kurudi hakuna kitu x2

title: Ee Baba Wangu
lyrics:
1. Ee Yahweh wangu wanijua, kutoka tumboni
mwa mama yangu, sina budi kusema
wastahili, sifa na shukrani zikurudie
Sifa kwa Yahweh kwa matendo yake makuu,
mpigie Yahweh kelele za shangwe Nchi yote
na iimbe utukufu wake, kwa maana Yahweh
ametukuka x2

2. Wakati mimi nipatao shida duniani, mimi
hukuita ukaniitika, wewe ni msaada wangu
wa karibu, huniponya na shida zangu ee
Yahweh

3. Wakati mimi niko hapa duniani, baba wangu
naomba uwezo wako, ili niweze hila za
Shetani, kwa maana ameniandama pande zote

4. Walionizunguka baba siwaamini, hunichukia
wakisema mimi mjinga, lakini neno lako
hunitia nguvu, na tumaini la kuishi naye
Mwokozi

5. Hakika Yahweh amesikia sauti yangu,
amesikiliza maombi yangu, ahimidiwe
Yahweh wa majeshi, kwa fadhili za ajabu.

title: Baraka
lyrics:
1. Ee Yahweh wangu wokovu wangu mchana na
usiku, nimelia mbele zako, unitegee sikio lako
Baraka za Yahweh ni nani awezaye kuzuia,
alimbariki Yakobo na akamlaani Esau x2

2. Ndugu na dada yangu, wakati upatapo msiba,
usije kasahau ukasema ni laana ya mtu

3. Yahweh akaibariki siku ya saba ya Sabato, pia
kaitakasa, kaiteua na akapumzika

4. Ndugu na dada yangu, uyashike sana maagizo
ya Yahweh, mojawapo ni amri, ya pili ni
mafunzo ya Messiah.

title: Tazama
lyrics:
1. Yahweh akasema, sio vyema mtu huyu aishi
peke yake, kamfanyia msaidizi, wa kuishi
pamoja naye
Tazama umzuri mpenzi wangu (umzuri) x2
sana, macho yako ni kama ya hua, moyo wako
hauna hila x2

2. Nawe mpendwa, nakuomba univumilie, katika
mambo yetu yote, ili tuishi kwa amani

3. Pia mimi mpenzi wangu, nitakupenda kwa
moyo wangu, nawe nipe nafasi kwako,
tutaishi maisha ya furaha

4. Baba wetu tunakuomba, utupe moyo wa
uvumilivu, katika maisha haya mapya, ya hii
ndoa yetu

5. Wazazi wote wa pande zote asante, Yahweh
awabariki kwa kuwa kama sio ninyi pia sisi
hatungekuwepo

6. Baba wetu tunakuomba, utupe moyo wa
utiifu, pia moyo wa upendo, ili tuishi
kukupendeza.

title: Siku Ya Leo
lyrics:
1. Siku ya leo twashangilia ndugu na dada
waunganishwa, Yahweh, awalinde awaongeze
awanyunyizie baraka
Njooni tusherekee harusi ya wawili
wapendanao Yahweh awalinde, awaongoze,
awanyunyizie baraka x2

2. Nyote wawili mwaunganishwa na neno teule
la Yahweh, pasiwe na mmoja atakayekuja, ili
awatenganishe

3. Yahweh awalinde awaongoze, awape maisha
yenye furaha, muishi kwa raha mkipendana
mpaka mauti iwatenganishe.

title: Ee Yahweh Kimbilio Langu
lyrics:
1. Ee Yahweh kimbilio langu, tena u ngome
yangu, kila nikukimbiliapo ee Yahweh
hunituliza
Nioshe uovu wangu, nisafishe na hisopo, ili
nikufurahishe ee Yahweh maishani mwangu
x2

2. Ulimtoa mwanao aje hapa ulimwenguni, akafa
kwa dhambi zetu, ili tupate wokovu

3. Mitume waliteswa, wakauwawa bila hatia,
wakauwawa kwa mateso yote, wakavumilia

4. Pia na sisi twatazamia makuu mbele yetu,
ndiposa twakuomba uwe na sisi hadi mwisho

title: Chuki
lyrics:
1. Na hii ndio dua yangu, pendo lizidi kuwa
jingi, katika hekima na ufahamu, mpate kuwa
na mioyo safi
Chuki ni ya nini, na sisi wote ni waamini, kwa
nini tuchukiane, mmoja na mwingine x2.

2. Pendo la ndugu na dada, lisiwe na unafiki,
bali upendo wa ndugu, udumu ndani yenu

3. Kila amchukiaye ndugu yake, yeye ni muaji,
nanyi mwajua ya kwamba muuaji hana uzima

4. Tazama ilivyo vyema, mandugu wakae
pamoja, na upendo wake Yahweh, kama
mitume wake Messiah Yahshua

5. Upendo kama wa Messiah alivyotupenda sisi,
akajitoa kwa ajili yetu sadaka, dhabihu kwa
Yahweh.

title: Mateso
lyrics:
1. Kilio ninacholia, ni cha vita ya ulimwenguni,
Baba wangu naomba uniongoze na unilinde.
Mateso ninayoyapitia, Baba yangu ni
magumu, bali nikiwa na roho wako Yahweh,
Ataniongoza na anilinde, Ee Yahweh wangu
nikumbuke sasa, kwa maana adui ni wengi
wamenizunguka, waniangamize x2

2. Ndugu na dada yangu, mateso ni mengi
duniani, usione kama Baba amekusahau wewe

3. Siku zangu za ujanani mwangu ee Yahweh,
Usikumbuke, katika mienendo yangu yote iwe
ni ya kukufurahisha

4. Nilalapo niamkapo ee Yahweh, uniongoze na
roho wako, tena nitembeapo ee Yahweh
uniongoze na roho wako

5. Shida zote ninazopitia duniani, Baba wangu
wazijua, Nakuomba unikumbuke, Mwanao
Yahshua ajapo na ufalme.

title: Lisikilizeni
lyrics:
1. Lisikilizeni neno la Yahweh enyi wana wa
Isiraeli, kwa maana Yahweh ana mateto, nao
wakaao katika nchi.
Bali kama hamtaki kusikia, Roho yangu italia
kwa siri, kwa sababu ya kiburi chenu, jicho
langu litalia sana x2.

2. Ee Yahweh tumaini la Israeli, wote
wakuachao ee Yahweh, huandika katika
mchanga wa ardhi, kwa maana wamekuacha

3. Leo kama mtasikia sauti yake Yahweh baba,
msifanye migumu mioyo yenu, nanyi
mtabarikiwa

4. Amebarikiwa mtu yule anayemtegemea
Yahweh, ambaye Yahweh ni tumaini lake,
wakati wote amwitapo.

title: Mwimbieni Yahweh Kwa Furaha
lyrics:
1. Mwimbieni Yahweh kwa furaha x2 Mjue ya
kwamba anaweza x2
(Eloi x3 Yahweh) x2

2. Mwimbieni Yahweh kwa upendo x2 Mjue ya
kwamba anaponya x2

3. Mwimbieni Yahweh kwa kuruka x2 Mjue ya
kwamba anarudi x2

4. Arubaini na saba ni Zaburi x2 Mwimbieni
Yahweh kwa makofi x2 Mjue ya kwamba
anaweza x2

title: Msifadhaikeni Moyoni Mwenu
lyrics:
1. Msifadhaikeni moyoni mwenu, ni mimi
Yahshua wenu nitakaa nanyi x2
Nyumba mwa Baba yangu, makao ni mengi x2

2. Unapopata shida moyoni mwako, lilia
Yahshua aliyekuita x2

3. Mimi ndimi njia kweli ya uzima, ya kwenda
kwa Baba x2

title: Natoa Shukurani Kwa Mwokozi
lyrics:
1. Natoa shukrani kwa mwokozi, aliyenifia pale
mtini x2
(Kweli) Mwokozi wangu ni wa huruma,
kakubali kuubeba mzigo wangu x2

2. Mimi sikuwa na chochote, akaja akaniokoa
uzima wangu x2

3. Yahshua alifia yeyote, alifia matajiri na
masikini x2

title: Tumekombolewa
lyrics:
NA DAMU YA
DHAMANA

1. Tumekombolewa na damu ya dhamana,
Tumekuwa wateule wake Yahshua x2
(Ni Yahshua x2) alilia (Eloi x2) lama
sabakithani x2

2. Alikiri neno kwake Ibrahimu, na uzao wake
ahadi ni Messiah x2

3. Sisi si wageni tena wa kuamini, tumekuwa
wenyeji pamoja na Messiah x2

4. Tumekuwa wana wa ahadi kupitia, damu ya
agano yake Yahshua Messiah x2

title: Imefika Pasaka
lyrics:
YA YAHSHUA WETU

1. Imefika pasaka ya Yahshua wetu, ni sikukuu
ya Yahshua mwezi wa kwanza x2
Halleluyah Hossanah tufurahie, Pasaka yake
Yahshua ndiye uzima x2

2. Tarehe kumi na nne mwezi wa kwanza,
tumfanyie Yahshua wetu Pasaka x2

3. Mwili wake Yahshua na damu yake, katikati
uzima na hukumu x2

4. Alaye mwili wake na damu yake, atapata
uzima wa milele x2

title: Kitabu Cha Kutoka
lyrics:
1. Kitabu cha Kutoka soma ufahamu, safari ya
Waisraeli walipokuwa jangwani x2
Wewe usiwe kama wana wa Isiraeli,
walipokuwa jangwani walimkosea Yahweh x2

2. Baharini mwa Shamu walikosa kusikia, na
baada ya kuvuka waliona maajabu x2

3. Walisema hawana maji safarini mwa Kanani,
Musa akakasirika akaligonga jiwe x2

4. Walisema hawana nyama safarini mwa
Kanani, Yahweh akawapa nyama wakala
zikawanyonga x2

title: Ee Yahweh Sikia
lyrics:
1. Ee Yahweh sikia sauti yangu, usikilize kilio
changu, nitegee sikio lako (usikilize maombi
yangu) x2.
Nitamwimbia Yahweh wimbo mpya, kwa
maana ametenda makuu, nitangaze fadhili
zake (alizonitendea mimi) x2.

2. Njoni tumwimbie Yahweh baba, tumfanyie
shangwe mwamba wetu, tuje mbele zake kwa
shukurani (tumfanyie shangwe kwa Zaburi)
x2.

3. Yahweh yu karibu na watu wake, Walio
bondeka mioyo yao (huwaokoa na
kuwaponya) x2.

4. Msifuni ee Yahrusalemu, Msifuni ee Zayuni,
kwa maana amekuchagua (kutoka mataifa
mengi) x2.

5. Heri wamtumainio Yahweh wao, ni kama
mlima Zayuni ambao hautingiziki (bali
utadumu milele) x2.

title: Hapo Mwanzo Palikuweko Neno
lyrics:
1. Hapo mwanzo palikuweko neno, nalo neno
lilikuwa kwa Yahweh, hilo neno ndiye
Yahweh, Nuru yetu itufikishe ng'ambo x2
Ng'ambo- Ng'ambo ile ina uzima, ng'ambo-
ng'ambo ile ina upendo, ng'ambo- ng'ambo ile
ina amani, ng'ambo- ng'ambo ni ya utukufu
milele x2

2. Hilo neno litadumu milele, ndani ya wote
wale waaminifu, tena ndilo litawaongoza,
wafike ng'ambo wafike uzimani x2

3. Aliye na kiu neno lamuita, ili aje
aburudishwe, mwenye njaa neno ni mkate, wa
uzima kamwe hautaisha x2

4. Ufunuo ishirini na moja, hataingia aliye na
chuki, wala uongo mule uzimani, wataingia
waliotakaswa x2

5. Asiye na neno hanaye Yahweh, asiye na amri
hana uzima, tukaze mwendo Wamessiah
wenzangu, ili tufike ng'ambo uzimani. x2

title: Nilikuwa Mbali
lyrics:
NA WOKOVU

1. Nilikuwa mbali na wokovu, Kwa huruma
Yahshua akanifia, Mimi ni wake leo na milele,
Hali na mali nimtumikie
(Toaa) Toa mali yako, toa mwili wako, Maisha
yako kwa Yahweh Muumba

2. Kitabu cha Malaki kinasema, umtolee fungu la
kumi, na sadaka na roho yako yote, utajaziwa
mpaka itiririke

3. Abrahamu ni kielelezo, kweli vyote ni vya
Yahweh Muumba, kamwambia tazama nyuma
yako, kondoo wa sadaka yu tayari

4. Usimdanganye Yahweh Muumba, kumbuka
Anania na mkewe, usile vyako na vya Muumba,
na utaona ukarimu wake.

title: We All Sing
lyrics:
We all sing wih joy and say we HalelluYah x2

1. We all sing with joy and We say
halelluYah

title: Praise Yahweh
lyrics:
Praise Yahweh now through Messiah Yahshua,
Gather together today for the feast of
Messiah's supper (x2)

1. Scoffer denies it all, the day of the
awesome return of Yahweh Shammah (x2)

2. Sun set on the horizon, now a new day has
begun; The law and prophet and the
writing—Kingdom of Yahweh, everlasting
peace (x2)

3. Glory and honor and blessing; Yahweh, the
only source of power; Savior yesterday and
today, forever chose to be (x2)

4. Gather us oh father Yahweh, in the greatest
wedding feast; As it were in the days of
Noah—many are called but few were chosen
(x2)

5. Surely he will come in the air, HalleluYah
Yahweh Shammah; Many are as it is to love,
yet break the law (x2)

6. Scoffer denies it all, nasty generation;
Scoffer denies it all, the day of the awesome
return of Yahweh Shammah; The law, the holy
law—Praise Yahweh Shammah, praise
Yahweh now (x2)

title: Hear The Voice (Sauti yake ni Yahshua)
lyrics:
1. Hark the voice of Yahshua crying, "Who
will go and work today?" Fields are white and
harvest waiting, who will bear the sheaves
away? Loud and strong the Master calleth,
rich reward he offers thee; Who will answer,
gladly saying, "Here am I, send me, send
me"?

2. If you cannot speak like angels, you can tell
the love of Yahshua; You can say he died for
all. If you cannot rouse the wicked with the
judgment’s dread alarms, You can lead the
little children to the Savior’s waiting arms.

3. If among the older people you may not be
apt to teach, "Feed my lambs," said Messiah
our shepherd, "place the food within their
reach." And it may be that the children you
have led with trembling hand, Will be found
among your jewels when you reach the better
land.

4. Let none hear you idly saying, "There’s
nothing I can do," While souls of men are
dying and the Master calls for you; Take the
task he gives you gladly, let his work your
pleasures be; Answer quickly when he calleth:
"Here am I, send me, send me!"

title: Take Time To Be Good (Tafuta Daima)
lyrics:
1. Take time to be good, speak often with thy
Yah; Abide in him always and feed on his
word. Make friends of Yah’s children, help
those who are weak; Forgetting in nothing his
blessings to seek.

2. Take time to be good, the world rushes on;
Spend much time in secret with Yahshua
alone. By looking to Yahshua, like him thou
shalt be; Thy friends in thy conduct his
likeness shall see.

3. Take time to be good, let him be thy guide;
And run not before him, whatever betides. In
joy or in sorrow, still follow thy Yah; And
looking to Yahshua, still trust in his word.

4. Take time to be good, be calm in thy soul;
Each thought and each temper beneath his
control. Thus led by his spirit to fountains of
love, Thou soon shalt be fitted for service
above.

title: Come To The Savior (Twende kwa Yah)
lyrics:
1. Come to the Savior, make no delay; Here in
his word he shows us the way. Here in our
midst he’s standing today, Tenderly saying,
"Come!"
Chorus: Joyful, joyful will the meeting be,
When from sin our hearts are pure and free;
And we shall gather, Savior, with thee In our
eternal home.

2. "Suffer the children," oh, hear his voice!
Heed now his blest command and obey; Hear
now his accents tenderly say, "Will you my
children come?"

title: Courage Brother
lyrics:
1. Courage brother! Do not stumble, though
thy path be dark as night; There’s a star to
guide the humble: "Trust in Yah and do the
right." Let the road be rough and dreary and
its end far out of sight; Foot it bravely! Strong
or weary: "Trust in Yah and do the right."

2. Perish policy and cunning, perish all that
fears the light! Whether losing, whether
winning: "Trust in Yah and do the right."
Simple rule and safest guiding, inward peace
and inward light; Star upon our path abiding:
"Trust in Yah and do the right."

3. Some will hate thee, some will love thee,
some will flatter, some will slight; Cease from
man and look above thee: "Trust in Yah and
do the right." Courage brother! Do not
stumble, though thy path be dark as night;
There’s a star to guide the humble: "Trust in
Yah and do the right."

title: Oh Happy Day
lyrics:
1. Oh happy day! That fixed my choice on
thee, my Savior and my Yah; Well may this
glowing heart rejoice and tell its raptures all
abroad.
Chorus: Happy day, happy day, when
Yahshua washed my sins away! He teaches me
to watch and pray, and stay rejoicing
everyday; Happy day, happy day, when
Yahshua washed my sins away.

2. It’s done! The great transaction is done! I
am my Yah’s and he is mine; He drew me and
I followed on, charmed to confess the voice
divine.

3. Now rest, my long-divided heart; fixed on
this blissful centre, rest; Nor ever from thy
Yah depart, with him of every good possessed.

4. High heaven that heard the solemn vow,
that vow renewed shall daily hear; Till in life’s
latest hour I bow, and bless in death a bond so
dear.

title: Yahshua Is Tenderly Calling (Yahshua akuita)
lyrics:
1. Yahshua is tenderly calling thee home,
calling today, calling today! Why from the
sunshine of love wilt thou roam, farther and
farther away?
Chorus: Calling today! Calling today!
Yahshua is calling, is tenderly calling today!

2. Yahshua is calling the weary to rest, calling
today, calling today! Bring him thy burden
and thou shalt be blest, he will not turn thee
away.

3. Yahshua is waiting, oh, come to him now;
waiting today, waiting today! Come with thy
sins, at his feet lowly bow; come and no
longer delay!

4. Yahshua is pleading, oh list to his voice;
hear him today, hear him today! They who
believe on his name shall rejoice; quickly
arise and away!

title: Come You That Love Yah
lyrics:
1. Come you that love our Yah, and let your
joys be known; Join in a song with sweet
accord, and thus surround the throne. (x2)
Chorus: We’re marching to Zion, beautiful,
beautiful Zion; We’re marching upward to
Zion, the beautiful city of Yah. (x2)

2. Let those refuse to sing who never knew
our Yah; But children of the heavenly King
must speak their joys abroad. (x2)

3. The hill of Zion yields a thousand sacred
sweets; Before we reach the heavenly fields or
walk the golden streets. (x2)

4. Then let our songs abound and every tear
be dry; We’re marching through Immanuel’s
ground to fairer worlds on high.

title: I Love Your Name
lyrics:
1. Yahweh, I really love your name; Yahshua,
I cherish your name. Yahshua, in humble
adoration, oh Yahweh, I worship your name.
(x2)

2. You are the pillar of my salvation; you are
the solid rock I stand. You are the Lion of the
tribe of Judah; oh Yahweh, on you I depend.
(x2)

3. You are the light and the way; you are the
truth and the life. You are the Savior to the
world; oh Yahweh, you are all in all. (x2)

4. Dear Yah, my hands are lifted up; darling,
I'm kneeling before you. These songs are from
my mouth, oh my Yah, you are my
sweetheart. (x2)

title: Take A Walk
lyrics:
1. Take a walk on the water of life and he
won't let you down; For by faith you must
believe that the law will set you free. (x2)
Chorus: If you believe and show it by your
works, You will receive a crown which no man
may take; Trust in Yahweh, my friend, love
him to the end; He’ll bless your life as you
know it on this earth. (x2)

2. He’s the way, the truth, and the life; out of
darkness you will see the light. Trust in him,
he will show you the way to live your life
each and every day. (x2)

3. If you look at things that passed you have
done, and you feel life has passed you by; You
will see you have just begun to live your life
with Yahweh and his son. (x2)

title: There’s A Fountain
lyrics:
1. There’s a fountain filled with the blood
drawn from Immanuel’s veins; And sinners
plunged beneath that flood lose all their guilty
stains.
Chorus: I do believe, I will believe that
Yahshua died for me; That on the post he shed
his blood from sin to set me free.

2. The dying lamb rejoiced to see that
fountain in his day; And there may I, though
vile as he, wash all my sins away.

3. Dear dying lamb, thy precious blood shall
never lose its power; Till all ransomed
assemblies of Yah be saved, to sin no more.

4. E’er since, by faith, I saw the stream thy
flowing wounds supply; Redeeming love has
been my theme and shall be till I die.

5. Then in a nobler, sweeter song, I’ll sing thy
power to save, When this poor lisping,
stammering tongue lies silent in the grave.

title: Pray For The Peace
lyrics:
1. We were glad when they told us, "Let’s go
to the house of Yahweh." Our feet shall stand
in your lovely gates, Yahrusalem. (x2)
Chorus: Pray for the peace of Yahrusalem;
may they have peace who love you. Because of
the house of Yahweh, we pray for your peace.
(x2)

2. Yahrusalem, a compact city where Yahweh’s
tribes go up; To give thanks as a testimony for
Israel, Yahweh’s name. (x2)

3. The David’s thrones are set for judgments;
pray for the peace of Yahrusalem. They shall
all have peace who love your city of Zion.
(x2)

4. Peace within your walls, Yahrusalem,
Yahweh’s blessing in your palaces; For our
brothers’ and friends’ sake, we say peace be
with you. (x2)

title: Day Is Dying
lyrics:
1. Day is dying in the west; heaven is
touching earth with rest. Wait and worship
while the night sets her evening lamps alight
through all the sky.
Chorus: Glory! Glory! Glory! our Yah of
host! Heaven and earth are full of thee;
Heaven and earth are praising thee, O Yah
most high.

2. Yah of life beneath the dome of the
universe, thy home; Gather us who seek thy
face to the fold of thy embrace, for thou art
nigh.

title: Glory Be Your Great Name
lyrics:
1. Oh you servants of Yahweh, praise the
name of Yahweh; Glory be the name of
Yahweh, now and forever. (x2)
Chorus: From the rising of the sun to the
sun's going down, Yahweh’s name is to be
praised! HalleluYah Yahweh! (x2)

2. Yahweh is high above all nations of the
earth, And Yahweh’s glory is above the
heavens. (x2)

3. Who is like Yahweh our father, who lives in
righteousness? Who humbles himself to
behold all in heaven and earth. (x2)

4. He makes barren women keep house as
joyful mothers; HalleluYah Yahweh, praises
and blessings to your great name. (x2)

title: There Is A Lamp
lyrics:
1. There is a lamp in every soul, some brightly
shining, some dark and cold. There is a Savior
in all these souls; ignite a flame and make
them bright. (x2)
Chorus: And so carry out your lamp, run to
the darkness; Seek out the hopeless, confused
and torn. Carry out your lamp for all to see it;
Carry your lamp, go light your world! (x2)

2. Look at my brother, the way he is trying to
light his candle some other way; Look at my
sister, the way she is trying to light her candle
some other way. (x2)

title: Behold Bless Yahweh
lyrics:
1. Behold, bless Yahweh, all you servants of
Yahweh; Who stand by the night in the house?
Stand in the house of Yahweh. All servants of
Yahweh, lift your hands; praise him in
Yahweh’s sanctuary. (x2)

2. Behold, bless Yahweh, all you servants of
Yahweh; Lift your hands, praise him in
Yahweh's sanctuary; lift hands and bless him.
May Yahweh who made heaven and all earth
bless you from out of Zion. (x2)

title: Here In World
lyrics:
1. Here in the world I'm passing by; I am not a
member to live forever. Today, tomorrow, I
may be gone; how good it is to know my
way? (x2)
Chorus: How good it is! How good it is! To
be born again? To be set free? To be a Zion
member? How good it is to know my way!
(x2)

2. Oh dear friends who are not free, come to
the redeemer, you will be set free. On our way
we go together; how good it is to know my
way. (x2)

3. My redeemer is waiting for me; angels are
there singing forever. Waiting for me to go
and rejoice; how good it is to know my way?
(x2)

title: Arise And Shine
lyrics:
Chorus: Arise and shine, give Yah his honor;
Arise and shine, give Yah his honor; Arise and
shine, give Yah his honor; Glory, honor to his
name!

1. Moses prayed, and the Red Sea was divided
(x3); Glory, honor to his name.

2. Daniel prayed, and the lions became his
porch (x3); Glory, honor to his name.

title: Rejoice (philippians 4)
lyrics:
Rejoice, rejoice and again I say rejoice!
Rejoice in Yahshua always, and again I say
rejoice! (x2)

title: The Long We Waited
lyrics:
1. The long we waited, now has come for us
to tell you goodbye; Even though it's sad to
say it now, Yahweh will make you to bear it.
(x2)
Chorus: We were together so long; the way
we stayed, you fed us with your love. Say
peace be with you and let the spirit fall upon
us now; Say you remember us just in prayers.
(x2)

2. The doors are now open so wide for us to
tell you goodbye; We won’t forget you; in the
next world, we shall be together. (x2)

title: Have You Been To Yahshua
lyrics:
1. Have you been to Yahshua for the cleansing
power? (x2) Are you washed in the blood of
the Lamb? Are you fully trusting in his grace
this hour? Are you washed in the blood of the
Lamb?
Chorus: Are you washed in the blood, in the
soul-cleansing blood of the Lamb? Are your
garments spotless? Are they white as snow?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

2. Are you walking daily by the Savior’s side?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb? Do
you rest each moment in the impaled? Are
you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

3. When the Bridegroom cometh, will your
robes be white? Pure white in the blood of the
Lamb? Will your soul be ready for the
mansions bright, And be washed in the blood
of the Lamb?

4. Lay aside the garments that are stained with
sin, And be washed in the blood of the Lamb;
There’s a fountain flowing for the soul
unclean; Oh, be washed in the blood of the
Lamb!

title: My Faith
lyrics:
1. My faith looks up to thee, thou Lamb of
Calvary, Savior divine; Now hear me while I
pray, take all my guilt away; oh let me from
this day be wholly thine!

2. May thy rich grace impart strength to my
fainting heart, my zeal inspire; As thou hast
died for me, oh may my love to thee pure,
warm, and changeless be—a living fire!

3. When life’s dark maze I tread and griefs
around me spread, be thou my guide; Bid
darkness turn to day, wipe sorrow’s tears
away, nor let me ever stray from thee aside.

4. When ends life’s transient dream, when
death’s cold sullen stream shall o'er me roll;
Blest Savior, then in love, fear and distrust
remove; oh, bear me safe above—a ransomed
soul.

title: Pass Me Not
lyrics:
1. Pass me not, oh gracious Savior, hear my
humble cry; While on others thou art calling,
do not pass me by.
Chorus: Savior, Savior, hear my humble cry;
While on others thou art calling, do not pass
me by.

2. Let me at a throne of mercy find a sweet
relief; Kneeling there in deep contrition, help
my unbelief.

3. Trusting only in thy merit, would I seek thy
face? Heal my wounded, broken spirit; save
me by thy grace.

4. Thou, the spring of all my comfort, more
than life to me; Who have I on earth beside
thee? Whom in heaven but thee?

title: What A Friend
lyrics:
1. What a friend we have in Yahshua, all our
sins and griefs to bear! What a privilege to
carry everything to Yahweh in prayer! Oh
what peace we often forfeit! Oh what needless
pain we bear! All because we do not carry
everything to Yahshua in prayer.

2. Have we trials and temptations? Is there
trouble anywhere? We should never be
discouraged; take it to Yahshua in prayer. Can
we find a friend so faithful, who will all our
sorrow share? Yahshua knows our every
weakness; take it to Yahshua in prayer.

3. Are we weak and heavy laden, cumbered
with a load of care? Precious Savior, still our
refuge; take it to Yahshua in prayer. Do thy
friends despise, forsake thee? Take it to
Yahshua in prayer; In his arms he’ll take and
shield thee; thou wilt find a solace there.

title: Yahshua My Saviour
lyrics:
1. Yahshua my Savior divine, Messiah, oh we
know you; Singing together, praising Messiah,
oh we never fail.
Chorus: Happy we are, happy we should be,
happy forever more; Singing together,
praising Messiah, oh we never fail.

2. Yahshua provider divine, Messiah, oh we
know you; Singing together, praising our
Savior, oh we never fail.

title: What Can Wash Away My Stains
lyrics:
1. What can wash away my stains? Nothing
but the blood of Yahshua! What can make me
whole again? Nothing but the blood of
Yahshua!
Chorus: Oh precious is the flow that makes
me white as snow! No other fount I know,
nothing but the blood of Yahshua.

2. For my cleansing this I see: nothing but the
blood of Yahshua! For my pardon this I plea:
nothing but the blood of Yahshua!

3. Nothing can for sin atone: nothing but the
blood of Yahshua! Not of good that I have
done: nothing but the blood of Yahshua!

4. This is all my hope and peace: nothing but
the blood of Yahshua! This is all my
righteousness: nothing but the blood of
Yahshua!

title: Yahweh I Hear
lyrics:
1. Yahweh, I hear of showers of blessings thou
art scattering full and free; Showers the thirsty
land refreshing; let some drops now fall on
me. (Even me x2)

2. Pass me not, oh gracious Father; sinful
though my heart may be, Thou might’st leave
me, but the rather let thy mercy light on me.
(Even me x2)

3. Pass me not, oh tender Savior; let me love
and cling to thee; I am longing for thy favor;
whilst thou art calling, oh call me. (Even me
x2)

4. Pass me not, oh mighty Spirit; thou can’st
make the blind to see; Witness of Yahshua’s
merit; speak the word of power to me. (Even
me x2)

5. Love of Yah, so pure and changeless; blood
of Messiah, so rich and free; Grace of Yah, so
strong and boundless; magnify them all in me.
(Even me x2)

6. Pass me not; thy lost one bringing, bind my
heart, oh Yah, to thee; Whilst the streams of
life are springing, blessing others, oh bless
me. (Even me x2)

title: Abide With Me
lyrics:
1. Abide with me, fast falls the eventide; The
darkness deepens; Yah, with me abide. When
other helpers fail and comforts flee, Help of
the helpless, oh abide with me.

2. Swift to its close ebbs out life’s little day;
Earth’s joys grow dim, its glories pass away.
Change and decay in all around I see; O thou
who changest not, abide with me.

3. I need thy presence every passing hour;
What but thy grace can foil the tempter's
power? Who like thyself my guide and stay
can be? Through cloud and sunshine, Yah,
abide with me.

4. I fear no foe, with thee at hand to bless; Ills
have no weight, and tears no bitterness.
Where is death’s sting? Where, grave, thy
victory? I triumph still, if thou abide with me.

5. Reveal thyself before my closing eyes;
Shine through the gloom and point me to the
skies. Heaven’s morning breaks and earth’s
vain shadows flee; In life, in death, oh Yah,
abide with me.

title: Yah Be With You
lyrics:
1. Yah be with you till we meet again! By his
counsels guide, uphold you, with his sheep
securely fold you; Yah be with you till we
meet again!
Chorus: Till we meet... till we meet... till we
meet at Yahshua’s feet; Till we meet... till we
meet... Yah be with you till we meet again!

2. Yah be with you till we meet again! 'Neath
his wings securely hide you, daily manna still
provide you; Yah be with you till we meet
again!

3. Yah be with you till we meet again! When
life’s perils thick confound you, put his loving
arms around you; Yah be with you till we
meet again!

4. Yah be with you till we meet again! Keep
love’s banner floating o'er you, smite death’s
threatening wave before you; Yah be with you
till we meet again!

title: Sowing In The Morning
lyrics:
1. Sowing in the morning, sowing seeds of
kindness, Sowing in the noontide and the
dewy eves; Waiting for the harvest and the
time of reaping, We shall come rejoicing,
bringing in the sheaves.
Chorus: Bringing in the sheaves, bringing in
the sheaves, We shall come rejoicing, bringing
in the sheaves.

2. Sowing in the sunshine, sowing in the
shadows, Fearing neither clouds nor winter's
chilling breeze; By and by the harvest and the
labor ended, We shall come rejoicing,
bringing in the sheaves.

title: My Hope Is Built
lyrics:
1. My hope is built on nothing less than
Yahshua’s blood and righteousness; I dare not
trust the sweetest frame, but wholly lean on
Yahshua’s name.
Chorus: On Yahweh the solid rock I stand, All
other ground is sinking sand.

2. When darkness seems to veil his face, I rest
on his unchanging grace; In every high and
stormy gale, my anchor holds within the veil.

3. His oath, his covenant, and blood support
me in the whelming flood; When all around
my soul gives way, he then is all my hope and
stay.

title: I Must Have The Savior
lyrics:
1. I must have the Savior with me, for I dare
not walk alone; I must feel his presence near
me and his arms around me thrown.
Chorus: Then my soul shall fear no ill; let
him lead me where he will. I will go without a
murmur and his footsteps follow still.

2. I must have the Savior with me, for my
faith at best is weak; He can whisper words of
comfort that no other voice can speak.

3. I must have the Savior with me in the
onward march of life; Through the tempest
and the sunshine, through the battles and the
strife.

4. I must have the Savior with me, and his
eyes the way must guide; Till I reach the
valley of Jordan, till I cross the rolling tide.

title: Don’t Tell Lies
lyrics:
1. Children, don’t tell lies to your mummy;
children, never tell lies to your daddy.
Children, make sure you tell them the truth; If
you tell them the truth, they will love you
more and more, And Yahshua will be your
friend. (x2)

2. Yahshua so much loves little children; he
loves us, so we ought to love him also; By
doing what he says in the scripture, be honest
to your parents; Yahshua bless you to be his.
(x2)

3. I am a covenant child of Yahshua; I will
abide by the word of my Yahshua. My
parents, I will never fail you; I will be a help
to you, never be a prodigal child; I will always
obey. (x2)

4. Parents, we are the future of a country, so
treat us like leaders of tomorrow. Please show
us the right way to follow; with a good
foundation of honesty and hard labor, We get
the Promised Land.

title: Our Sisters (don’t Mind)
lyrics:
1. Our sisters listen to us, our brothers listen
to us; We want to tell you about our faith and
hope.
Chorus: Don’t mind our age, don’t mind our
background; We want to tell you about our
faith and hope. Don’t mind our age, don’t
mind our background; We want to tell you
about our destiny.

2. For I know that Yahshua came and died;
For me he washed my sins and made me pure.

3. For I serve my Yah with all my heart; For I
am truly waiting for new Yahrusalem. Sing
hosanna, sing halleluYah, oh sing and dance;
Yahweh is our destiny.

4. For you know that our Yah will give you
strength; For you to conquer till you reach
your destiny.

title: My Sister What
lyrics:
1. My sister, what shall you do? For the loving
Yahshua died for you. He says, "Listen to my
teaching and pay attention to what I say." He
says, "I am the giver of everlasting and eternal
life."

2. My brother, what shall you do? For the
loving Yahshua died for you.

title: To Yahweh Be The Glory
lyrics:
1. To Yahweh be the glory, great things he has
done! So he loved the world that he gave us
his son, Who yielded his life an atonement for
sin, And opened the life gate that we may go
in.
Chorus: Praise Yahweh, praise Yahweh! Let
the earth hear his voice! Praise Yahweh,
praise Yahweh! Let the people rejoice! Oh
come to Yahweh the Father through Yahshua
the Son, And give him the glory—great things
he has done!

2. Perfect redemption, the purchase of blood,
to every believer the promise of Yah; The
vilest offender who truly repents, that moment
from Yahweh a pardon receives.

3. Great things he has taught us, great things
he has done; And great our rejoicing through
Yahshua the Son; But purer and higher and
greater will be our wonder, our blessings,
when Yahshua we see.

title: We Are The Foreigners
lyrics:
1. We are the foreigners in this world, and this
world is not our home; We have to stay on it
for a time, and then we go to our Father’s
home.
Chorus: Oh dear Yah, feel mercy on us; upon
our souls, dear Yah, feel mercy. The journey is
long enough, my Yah; but I believe it’s now no
more long. (x2)

2. As you come into this world, you will leave
it as you met it; Whether a king or a queen,
you will leave it as you met it.

3. Oh my mother, oh my father, oh love
Yahshua; He will give you the wonderful
power to overcome Satan, to overcome the
devil's power.

title: All Hail The Power
lyrics:
1. All hail the power of Yahshua’s name! Let
angels prostrate fall; Bring forth the royal
diadem, and crown him Yah of all. (x2)

2. Ye saints redeemed of Adam's race, ye
ransomed from the fall; Hail him who saves
you by his grace, and crown him Yah of all.

3. Sinners, whose love can never forget the
wormwood and the gall; Go spread your
trophies at his feet, and crown him Yah of all.

4. Let every kindred, every tribe on this
terrestrial ball; To him all majesty ascribe, and
crown him Yah of all.

5. Oh that with yonder sacred throng we at his
feet may fall; Join in the everlasting song, and
crown him Yah of all.

title: Messiah And The Multitude
lyrics:
1. Messiah was followed by the great
multitude; From different kinds of nations to
seek wisdom. (x2)
Chorus : On seeing the multitude, Yahshua
went up on a mountain; When he sat, his
disciples came to him, and he opened his
mouth to teach them

2. Yahshua taught them, saying he did not
come to destroy The law and prophets, but he
came to fulfill it. (x2)

3. Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is
the kingdom of Yahshua Messiah. (x2)

4. Blessed are those who are persecuted for
righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of
Zion. (x2)

5. Rejoice and be glad for the sake of Yahshua
Messiah, for great is your reward in the
kingdom of Yahshua. (x2)

title: Yahshua Is My Light
lyrics:
1. Yahshua is my light and salvation, whom
shall I fear? He is my strength, he is my life; I
am going to fear no one except Savior
Yahshua Messiah.
Chorus: To whom shall I cry except to my
Savior? My salvation, I can’t be silent. When I
call upon your name, Yahshua Messiah, hear
your son; Have mercy on me.

2. What profit is there in my life when I fall
down into the pit? I asked you, Yahshua, to be
my helper; hear your son, have mercy on me.

3. At the end, Yahweh, I shall praise your
name; I will give thanks to my redeemer, I
can’t be silent; Even a single minute, receive
my thanks forever. HalleluYah!

title: The Pentecost Day
lyrics:
1. When the day of Pentecost came, all
apostles assembled in Yahrusalem to
celebrate; The day of Pentecost, giving thanks
to the heavenly Father.
Chorus: This is the day that Yahweh has
made; let us make it a wonderful day. I will
praise my redeemer Yahweh; I will glorify his
holy name.

2. Our Father who art in heaven, give us your
true spirit to lead us in all our ways, The same
as you gave to the apostles.

3. When they were filled with the true spirit,
they began to speak in other tongues; All the
multitude became amazed, for the True Spirit
manifested.

4. While the multitude were still mocking,

title: Nearer My Yah To Thee
lyrics:
1. Nearer, my Yah, to thee, nearer to thee!
E’en though it be a stake that raiseth me; Still
all my song shall be, Nearer, my Yah, to thee,
nearer to thee!

2. Though like the wanderer, the sun gone
down, Darkness comes over me, my rest a
stone; Yet in my dreams I’d be, Nearer, my
Yah, to thee, nearer to thee!
